purpose: Generate a smaller, centered, visibly bilateral Delighted mouth after attempt 11 failed the native 200x200 black-pixel symmetry gate.

locked_v9_reference.use: sole visual reference for exact V9 identity, normal mouth scale, eye/highlight identity, nose axis and ink weight

reference_policy: The locked V9 sheet is the sole image input; attempt 11 is rejected evidence and is not an image-generation input.
identity_locks: Keep the exact V9 eyes, primary highlights, tiny sparkles, brows, cheeks, centered nose, face scale and monochrome ink weight.

mouth_contract: One small centered happy open smile, closer to the V9 normal-mouth scale than a grin: a short level upper curve, shallow lower curve, small centered white opening, mirrored left/right contour and rounded ends. native_review_gate.symmetry: after threshold and native scaling, left/right black-pixel mass difference <= 2 pixels and mouth bbox center within 1 pixel of the nose center axis
native_review_gate.manual_visual_triage: reject any bowl, oversized grin, diagonal mouth, asymmetric end, disconnected stroke, or mouth that looks unlike the cute V9 line language
